body:
The model picker for each role on the Settings page shows extra text after each model's name: the model id in brackets and, when the model can't start, the reason (for example "Command Code (deepseek) — No key yet; add one in Settings"). It should show only the model's name, as the task page's model picker does.

### Scope
- Each option in the role model picker shows just the model's name.
- The list of models offered, the "None (choose on each task)" choice, and the fallback for a saved model that isn't set up here stay as they are.
- The Models section higher on the page keeps showing ids and reasons; only the picker changes.
- Update any test that expects the old option wording.

### Pointers
- `settings.model_option_label` (settings) builds the extra text; `settings.model_options` uses it. The task page uses `solace_task.agent_option`, which returns the label alone.
- Test to check: `settings_test.role_models_load_save_and_fall_back_test`.
title: settings: role model picker shows names only
